mapper.select: SELECT p.principal_id AS "principalId", g.user_id AS "userId" FROM mcp_principal_credential c JOIN mcp_principal p ON p.principal_id = c.principal_id JOIN mcp_principal_user_grant g ON g.principal_id = p.principal_id WHERE c.credential_fingerprint = #{credentialFingerprint} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.revoked_at IS NULL AND c.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND g.revoked_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_access_audit ( principal_id, user_id, action, decision, target_kb_ids, correlation_id, reason_code, request_metadata ) VALUES ( #{principalId}, #{userId}, #{action}, #{decision}, CAST(#{targetKbIdsJson} AS jsonb), #{correlationId}, #{reasonCode}, CAST(#{requestMetadataJson} AS jsonb) )
